records.title: Modernisation of Mumbai Port
details: f: A 4.1 km dedicated freight corridor from Wadala to Kurla is being executed in coordination with Central Railway under the PM Gati Shakti initiative to facilitate efficient cargo movement through the Mumbai Port railway network. To support future cargo traffic, road infrastructure within the port is being upgraded with technical guidance from IIT Mumbai. Indian Port Rail Corporation Limited (IPRCL) is also undertaking detailed rail–road improvement measures in MbPA to reduce congestion and enhance cargo-handling efficiency. With support from Mumbai Port, the Mumbai Metropolitan Regional Development Authority (MMRDA) has planned Metro Line 11 through port land, which will significantly improve connectivity between the port area and the rest of the city. Additionally, MbPA, in collaboration with Central Railway, is planning to rail connectivity to strengthen overall transport integration.

records.title: National Waterways in Maharashtra.
details: c): One proposal for preparation of pre-feasibility study of Vidharbha Seaway Canal has been received from the Government of Maharashtra.

records.title: Nuclear Power Generation Capacity
details: d & e :Maharashtra. At present, detailed discussions on the Techno-Commercial Offer (TCO) submitted by M/s EDF, France are underway to arrive at a viable project proposal.
